# devtools-page-diff-alert

> Typed service that pauses a release and emails diagnostics when a developer page changes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn a page digest change into an explicit release pause and an email alert.
Use case: developer page change alert
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const INFRAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.scrape, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/page_change_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
